title: Incorrect boundary conditions in the Security: Process Sandboxing component
description: CVE-2026-92061 is a vulnerability in Microsoft Security's Process Sandboxing component caused by incorrect boundary conditions. The issue is identified as a CWE-119 type, which typically relates to improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. The affected version is Microsoft product version 4.0.
